data.narrative:
Steady Energy is a Series G climate and energy company founded by Tommi Nyman, Hannes Haapalahti, and Petteri Tenhunen, having raised €32M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of nine private frontier-tech peers in Climate & Energy (including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen) alongside one public comparable (LNZA).

Two standard triangulation methods were evaluated. Stage-progression analysis was deemed inapplicable because the implied base valuation of $1.8B—derived from total raised as a proxy—produces a 1.25x step-up to $2.2B, a multiple exceeding 20x the company's €32M in cumulative capital. This magnitude disconnection suggests the funding-tracker baseline is unreliable for this stage. Peer-median benchmarking was similarly rejected: while nine same-sector peers exist, filtering for stage-specificity and valuation comparability yielded fewer than the three datapoints required for robust triangulation. A broader all-sector median would introduce unacceptable noise.

The analysis is therefore inconclusive. No defensible valuation range emerges from available methods given data constraints. Resolution requires either (1) primary-source funding rounds and recent transaction data for Climate & Energy Stage G companies, (2) explicit revenue or EBITDA metrics for Steady Energy and peer set, or (3) direct market signals from ongoing fundraising. Until such inputs materialize, quantitative support for a specific valuation remains absent.
